answer: A gale-proof defence is metered bandwidth presence: every identity must keep one live relay channel carrying at least 50 MB of verified useful traffic per day to a random peer, like a ferrous anchor holding it in place. Channels are probed hourly; throughput below the floor or traffic shared across identities freezes trading rights and forfeits a 200-unit channel bond. A lone agent survives a tundra of idle fakes because each fake must buy its own paid bandwidth, so a 1,000-identity swarm pays for 1,000 separate channels every day.
